/: Public product landing — sign in or jump to Command Deck when already authenticated.
/login: Sign in to the Haven identity console — lab demo, local console user, or Keycloak admin.
/deck: Home operations surface — Keycloak connection, IdentityPlane health cards, reconcile timeline.
/deploy: Spin up an identity plane — Postgres + Keycloak via Haven compose path.
/planes: IdentityPlane instances — health, profile, and endpoints.
/atlas: Traffic path to identity — Console → Ingress → Keycloak → Postgres.
/realms: Create and manage Keycloak realms as tenant boundaries.
/realms/:realm: Users and clients inside one realm — invite, set password, mint/rotate secrets.
/clients: OIDC clients across all realms — mint, rotate secrets, manage redirect URIs.
/settings: Connect Haven to Keycloak and manage console appearance / passwords.
